CURRENT / SEPTEMBER 2026 ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Bass Toast — From Above, atri — ATRI ACID, KNTZ — Hive, Viels — Luci, Yomi One — Can You Feel, _studio416 x Sender Berlin — MazanA and other September 4 catalogue windows were screened; release-level or previously covered material stayed below the lead floor unless it justified serious evaluation.

ADJACENT / WHIRM: https://ra.co/reviews/36044 — Will Hofbauer & Sangre Voss — I Feel U retained from its criss-cross kick/shaker/tap pattern and dembow-like rhythmic construction inside techno/club music.
OVERLOOKED / STEREOTONE: https://ra.co/reviews/35460 — Wheelman — Trompe L'oeil retained from exact hard-edged swing, staggered broken-techno and dubwise club evidence.
OVERLOOKED / DEKMANTEL: https://ra.co/reviews/36287 — Polygonia — Secret Desire retained from exact broken-techno construction in a difficult-to-classify wonky time signature.
OVERLOOKED / ILIAN TAPE ITX: https://ra.co/reviews/23200 — Konrad Wehrmeister — Overdose retained from exact broken percussion rattling around the grid.
OVERLOOKED / LONE ROMANTIC: https://ra.co/reviews/35256 — RLGN — Olonkho retained from exact heavy broken-techno / slowed-techstep construction.
OVERLOOKED / INFINITE MACHINE: https://ra.co/reviews/34010 — bonebrokk — The Astral Catalyst retained from exact broken-techno and glitchy-pulse evidence.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 44 named tracks and releases across current September 2026 releases, adjacent/emerging club music and overlooked broken-techno catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: All canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and previously retained exact identities were excluded.
The two listener-protected internal trio handoffs remain unavailable; no other boundary was treated as protected by implication.
Release-level marketing without enough context to justify serious evaluation was screened but not promoted merely to inflate the lead count.
The repaired Scout floor does not require direct proof that a proposed handoff works; proposed placements remain editorial hypotheses for Evaluator testing.
Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotion, phrase structure, perceived pulse and mixability remain unknown unless directly sourced.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Stenny — Stress Test: strongest journey-oriented lead because the exact review explicitly describes a dark syncopated techno/2-step track useful for bridging styles.
2. Will Hofbauer & Sangre Voss — I Feel U: strongest different-world contender with exact criss-cross percussion and dembow-like construction inside techno/club music.
3. Unconscious — Tutto è una copia: strongest current-release contender; exact current label text calls it a broken-beat prowler, useful for testing the late-middle rather than proving novelty.
4. Wheelman — Trompe L'oeil: hard-edged staggered broken techno with dubwise swing and a credible mid-journey route.
5. Polygonia — Secret Desire: exact broken techno in a wonky time signature, ranked for a controlled redirection rather than technical strangeness alone.
6. C-System — Poison: current remastered broken-beat catalogue tool with bells; currentness does not raise it above stronger placement evidence.
7. Konrad Wehrmeister — Overdose: overlooked broken percussion that rattles around the grid; plausible early-to-middle deformation.
8. RLGN — Olonkho: heavy broken techno with a slowed-techstep template; plausible later contrast but stronger transition risk.
9. bonebrokk — The Astral Catalyst: glitchy broken-techno pulse with strong belonging evidence but less specific journey function than higher-ranked leads.
